handback.title: Shipped prompts fit any repo, with clear reviewer duties
handback.summary: The shipped role prompts drop Dokima's own examples, share one raising text, and spell out planner questions and reviewer duties.
handback.feature: Prompts fit any repo. Stories: (1) generic prompts and planner questions. (2) reviewer duties and boxes, after 1. (3) code checks the boxes, after 2.

stories.title: Generic shipped prompts and the planner's questions
stories.user_story: Any repo's agents get prompts with neutral examples, its own numbers, and clear rules for asking the owner.
stories.context: Already on main (#796, #803): the caps table, runner line, owner docs name and protected paths are drawn from settings by the prompt builder, and house rules are added after each role's prompt. Still open: the role files name Dokima files in their examples (planner lines 99 to 170, the raising block in all three roles), the raising block is copied three times, and the planner's 'more than 3 questions' and the 'three blocks in a row' lines are written in, while settings hold planner.max_questions and river.max_blocks. Code's own limits move to settings in #783. The two grade prompts are left out of scope. The owner's answer of 2026-10-17: the rewrite sizes are an estimate, not a requirement, so no size check; the two grade prompts staying as they are is a scope note, not a requirement. House rules per role shipped in #796; their criterion is proved by the existing tests 796.7 and 796.8, and the prompts.append line maps to it.

stories.title: The reviewer's prompt spells out its duties and boxes
stories.user_story: The reviewer's prompt names its four duties and the boxes it fills for each.
stories.context: The duties come from the owner's comment of 2026-10-15 on this issue; the boxes from the owner's next comment. Code flagging stale criteria is #743; this story only writes the duties into the prompt. Shares the prompt builder with story 1, so it takes its turn after it.

acceptance_criteria.words: Nothing dropped. Every sentence of the owner's maps to a criterion or is marked "not a requirement" with a reason.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Fixed prompt text; no input varies.

stories.title: Code checks the reviewer's required boxes
stories.user_story: A review that skips a duty, or claims a weak test without proof, is rejected before it posts.
stories.context: The review hand-back is checked in the agent checks module (verdict approve or block). Boxes: dropped, added, superseded, conflicts, edges, poor_tests, as the owner's comment shapes them. An added entry of kind needed is not a blocker. The owner's answer of 2026-10-17: boxes are required at plan review and at code review; a box with nothing to check at a stage says none; the boxes sit beside the existing asks, edge_cases and tests lists, which stay.

acceptance_criteria.text: A review missing any of the six boxes is rejected, naming the box.
acceptance_criteria.words: every box present

edge_cases.case: A box left empty instead of none is rejected.
At plan review, an added box saying none is accepted.
At code review, a review missing a box is rejected, naming the box.

acceptance_criteria.text: A box entry missing a field its shape needs is rejected, naming the field.
acceptance_criteria.words: entries typed

edge_cases.case: An added entry whose kind is not creep or needed is rejected.

acceptance_criteria.text: A weak test entry with no wrong code that still passes is rejected.
acceptance_criteria.words: A weak-test claim without a named counterexample is rejected by code.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: The missing counterexample itself is the case tested.

acceptance_criteria.text: A review that approves while any box holds a blocking entry is rejected.
acceptance_criteria.words: each entry a blocker unless noted
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Each box is tried in turn by the one test.

acceptance_criteria.text: An added entry of kind needed does not stop a review from approving.
acceptance_criteria.words: # needed is not a blocker

acceptance_criteria.words: edges:       per criterion: covered | missing: <named case>
